Independent project · Testing now

Picture a building. Get a scaled model you can draw from.

Drawvisio/n is AI-assisted 3D CAD for architects, built by bob, an architect and urban planner who spent many years at HOK. It runs in the browser: plans, 3D, sections and sheets in one model, driven from a typed command line or the mouse.

A small group of testers is helping shape it now. If you know how architects really draw, your eye is what it needs.

Familiar habits

Built around how architects draw

The command line takes short typed instructions with real dimensions, in metric or feet and inches. You can also click through each step with prompts, the way you would in AutoCAD.

  • Snaps on F3, F8, F9 and F10, with ortho, polar and a movable UCS.
  • Levels drive the model, so walls follow floor heights.
  • North, south, east and west elevations and section cuts come from the same model.
  • Layers with plot styles, line weights and line types.

Many of us drew with DrawVision at HOK. If you did too, tell bob which habits you would like back. That list shapes what gets built next.

# a wall run, typed › w 0,0 @6,0 @0,4 # repeat a line two feet up › rep lin . z 2' # set the sheet viewport scale › scale 1:100 # move from one point to another › m . from A to B # ask the assistant › ai two-storey house, 3 bed, pitched roof

Roadmap

Where it's going: from an idea to a model

The aim is an imagination tool. You describe what you picture, the assistant proposes, and Drawvisio/n measures and checks it at true scale.

StageWhat happensStatus
BriefSite, rooms and areas captured as a short brief card.In progress
MassingSeveral massing schemes to compare, built from simple solids.Working
PlanWalls, rooms and openings, checked against the brief's areas.Working
BuildingRoofs, stairs, materials and terrain added to the model.In progress
PresentationSheets, elevations, sections and styled 3D views.Working
